Landing Lab Three directions, one product

One fictional product page designed three ways, so hierarchy, tone and conversion can be compared side by side.

Role

Platforms

Year

The problem

Choosing a landing direction is difficult when visual style, content hierarchy and interaction decisions are mixed together in one unstructured draft.

What I did

  1. Explore

    Created three focused directions so typography, spacing, tone and content emphasis could be compared side by side.

  2. Refine

    Kept the information architecture consistent while varying visual language and interaction details.

  3. Build

    Implemented the explorations as a responsive React and TypeScript site with reusable layout patterns.

Where it stands

All three variants are live: minimal editorial, product-led SaaS and bold expressive, built from the same content so only the design changes.
